footer.bio: Andrea Tombolato: developer, volunteer, gamer. I am HeyAtom.

seo.description: I’m Andrea (HeyAtom), a full-stack developer since 2016. I build custom websites and web apps for associations, professionals and small organizations.
seo.ogDescription: Custom websites and web apps, built by one person. Vue, Nuxt, Node, NestJS and Java since 2016.

picks.kaish: Streamer Kaish79’s site: a build editor for Dead by Daylight, users and roles, and a fully translated game wiki.
picks.sgweb: A Tai Chi and Qi Gong teacher’s site: venues, schedules and direct contact, in Italian and English.
picks.beacon: The live page of a streamer team, on Twitch and Kick: who is on air, Discord alerts and stats for creators.
picks.title: Things I built that actually run.

offers.title: What I can do for you.
offers.intro: No packages, no price lists: I figure out what you need and suggest the simplest path that works. And I don’t start from scratch: logins, images, content, events and email sit on a {link} that’s already proven.

path.medas: Healthcare software with Java, Node.js and Vue: online records that give patients access to test results and clinical documents.
path.elementBoard: Board of a non-profit gaming community: I lead the dev team behind the site and infrastructure and take part in organizational decisions.
path.elementDev: The network’s web platform with Nuxt and Node.js, dashboards for teams and streamers, internal tools.
path.procivText: In charge of public communication since 2022: I relaunched our socials and built the group’s site from scratch.
path.intro: By day, healthcare software, where a mistake is never a detail. The rest of the time, community, volunteering and my own projects.

seo.description: The HeyAtom brand: mark, logo, colours, type and downloadable files.
seo.ogDescription: Mark, logo, colours and a kit to download.

brand.intro: How to use the HeyAtom mark: a hand saying hi, one green, two typefaces. Rules and files are below.

mark.title: The mark
mark.body: The Vulcan salute from Star Trek: openness, respect and a nerdy touch. “Hey” is the greeting, “Atom” the method: projects built one piece at a time.
mark.small: The mark stands alone wherever the full logo won't fit: favicons, avatars, the corner of a video.

logo.title: Logo
logo.body: Mark plus logotype in Manrope ExtraBold. The horizontal lockup is the default; the stacked one is for square formats.
logo.spaceBody: X is half the cap height. X between mark and name, at least 2X around the logo.

icon.title: Icon
icon.body: For apps, social profiles and home screens: white hand on a rounded square, main gradient or flat jade. Corners always round.

color.title: Colour
color.body: One solid colour, jade, used as light on the charcoal ground. The rest of the palette is for printed and social material, not the site.
color.extendedNote: Material and graphics only, never next to jade as a second accent.
color.gradientBody: 45°, from #00432B at 70% to solid #00A86B from 65%. The only gradient allowed on the mark.

type.title: Type
type.body: Manrope for everything you read, JetBrains Mono for data, dates and technical labels.

shape.title: Shapes and pattern
shape.body: Solid, rounded shapes, no sharp corners. The hex pattern only sits behind headings, at 10 to 20% opacity.

files.title: Files
files.body: SVG vectors, ready for web and print.
